safety_boundary: No live networks scanned. No external hosts contacted. Source analysis, existing tests, and fixture inspection only.

p1_findings.title: Four registered scan source types have no runner implementation
p1_findings.detail: ScanSourceType enum, scan_registry schema versions, and required fields definitions exist for google_workspace, aws, azure, and gcp. No bridge in services/field_assessment/connectors/ and no runner in services/connectors/ exists for any of these. Manual scan import works but automated runner execution is impossible.
p1_findings.mitigation: Operators can still upload external scan results via the manual ingest endpoint. Automated runner execution requires implementing the missing bridges.

p1_findings.title: DNS/Email connector does not validate domains through SafeTargetValidationService
p1_findings.detail: The dns_email runner (services/connectors/dns_email/runner.py) performs DNS queries for domains passed directly without routing through SafeTargetValidationService. The validator is a pure Python library and does not validate domain names for DNS safety — it validates IP/hostname/URL targets for socket-opening safety. DNS lookups against arbitrary domains carry different risk than sockets, but the asymmetry between dns_email and network_scan/web_headers creates a coverage gap in the documentation of the safety model.
p1_findings.mitigation: DNS queries are read-only passive operations. The practical exploit risk is low. Document the asymmetry explicitly in the safety architecture.

p1_findings.title: No ground-truth fixture tests for scanner detection accuracy
p1_findings.detail: No tests validate scanner outputs against known-answer fixtures (e.g., a mock network scan result confirming that specific port configurations are classified as UNSAFE_EXPOSED, or that specific SPF record strings produce the expected finding severity). Tests focus on API contract, payload validation, and evidence chain integrity, not detection accuracy.

safety_findings.audit_trail: every scan initiation, rejection, and completion logged to fa_scan_audit_events
safety_findings.target_persistence: every validated/rejected target stored in fa_verified_targets

limitations: Audit is source inspection only — no live scanning performed
Detection accuracy could not be verified without ground-truth fixtures
Microsoft Graph connector tests use mock tokens — no live tenant was tested
SharePoint connector scan limits (30 sites, 15 permission checks/drive) may undercount large tenants
AI tool vendor registry coverage not fully audited in this pass
No drift connector or Slack connector runners were inspected for this audit
